TermTranslation.definition: An operation to make an opening from the last part of the small intestine to the outside of the body through the belly.

TermTranslation.term: apishîsh chiki mâtishûkûn chitichishîhch anitâh châ uhchi chikimuhtâkiniwich wîhkwâyâu châ ishi wiyiwîpiyich chimâi
TermTranslation.term_syllabics: ᐊᐱᔒᔥ ᒋᑭ ᒫᑎᔔᑰᓐ ᒋᐳᑎᔒᐦᒡ ᐊᓂᑖᐦ ᒑ ᐅᐦᒋ ᒋᑭᒧᐦᑖᑭᓂᐎᒡ ᐐᐦᒀᔮᐤ ᒑ ᐃᔑ ᐎᔨᐐᐱᔨᒡ ᒋᒫᐃ
TermTranslation.public_note_en: a small incision will done on the small intestine to attach a colostomy bag for the elimination of bodily waste

TermTranslation.term: apishîsh chika mâtishûkûn chitachishîhch aniteh che uhchi chikamuhtâkanuwihch wîhkweyâu cheishi wîwîpayihch chimei
TermTranslation.term_syllabics: ᐊᐱᔒᔥ ᒋᑲ ᒫᑎᔔᑰᓐ ᒋᐴᒋᔒᐦᒡ ᐊᓂᑌᐦ ᒉ ᐅᐦᒋ ᒋᑲᒧᐦᑖᑲᓄᐎᐦᒡ ᐐᐦᑴᔮᐤ ᒉᐃᔑ ᐐᐐᐸᔨᐦᒡ ᒋᒣᐃ
TermTranslation.public_note_en: a small incision will done on the small intestine to attach a colostomy bag for the elimination of bodily waste
